no-restricted-syntax.message: Do not instantiate OpenAI directly. Use LLMClientFactory from common/llm/.
Do not instantiate Composio directly. Use ComposioService in connections/.
Do not create a DataSource directly. Use the shared DatabaseModule (one pool).
Read environment via AppConfigService (config module only).
